newsitem.title: USA: US 30-,15-yr mortgage rates unchanged this week.
newsitem.headline: US 30-,15-yr mortgage rates unchanged this week.

text.p: Average commitment rates on U.S. 30- and 15-year fixed-rate mortgages remained unchanged during the week ending July 18, Freddie Mac said Thursday.
Thirty-year mortgages remained steady in the week at an average 7.47 percent while 15-year mortgages stood at an average 7.01 percent, Freddie Mac reported.
One-year adjustable rate mortgages were up slightly, rising to 5.55 percent in the week from 5.53 percent last week.
A year ago, the 30-year rate averaged 8.23 percent, the 15-year 7.76 percent and the ARM 5.97 percent.
